correctness.rationale: A from-scratch independent implementation of 2x2 matrix multiplication modulo 13, PSL sign canonicalization, BFS, and reduced-word enumeration visited exactly 1092 PSL classes, reproduced spheres [1,4,12,25,48,96,180,279,317,120,10], diameter 10, and found zero reduced identities at lengths 1 through 5 and 28 at length 6. The stated word aaBaaB evaluates to -I and the stated diameter witness reaches a distance-10 class.
residual_risks: The proof is exhaustive finite computation rather than a hand derivation; it relies on exact integer modular arithmetic and BFS/word-enumeration logic.

final_claim: For the undirected Cayley graph of PSL(2,13) generated by the elementary transvection pair and inverses, the graph has 1092 vertices, exact diameter 10 with sphere distribution [1,4,12,25,48,96,180,279,317,120,10], and exact girth 6 with 28 reduced length-6 identities and none of length at most 5.
